ops.name: New Year's Eve Party Game Pack
ops.description:
Keep everyone playing all the way to the midnight countdown with 8 printable New Year's Eve games and activities. Family friendly, no drinking games, so kids, teens and grown-ups can all join in.

Great for family nights in, NYE parties, sleepovers and classroom celebrations with 3 to 30 people.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (12-page PDF)

  • How to play and print page with a party timeline
  • New Year's Trivia (20 questions) with answer key
  • New Year's Word Scramble (20 words) with answer key
  • This or That: New Year's Eve Edition (20 pairs)
  • Would You Rather: New Year's Eve (20 cut-out cards)
  • Find the Guest Bingo (mingle game)
  • My 2026 in Review keepsake page
  • My Predictions for 2027 (save it and check next year)
  • Countdown Scavenger Hunt (kids list and grown-ups list)
  • Party Scorecard

Details

  • US Letter size, also prints on A4 (choose Fit or Actual Size)
  • Mostly black and white with a navy accent, so it is ink friendly
  • Print as many copies as you need for your own party

How To Download

This is a digital PDF download. Nothing will be shipped. Right after purchase, Gumroad emails you the download link and the file is saved in your Gumroad Library. Print at home or at a local print shop.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the file.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
